name: Naiyang
intro: Nai Yang is a relaxed beach village inside Sirinat National Park, a few minutes from Phuket International Airport. It is known for its casuarina-lined beach, beachfront seafood restaurants and planes landing overhead.
overview:
Nai Yang is in the north-west of Phuket, in Thalang district, next to Nai Yang Beach and Sirinat National Park. The airport is only a short drive away: the project data gives about 2 km (7 minutes) for Botanica Skyport and descriptions of the condominiums put it at five to ten minutes, which is the main practical difference from the southern and central west-coast areas.
Most projects here are condominiums, mainly from Rhom Bho Property (The Title) plus The Balcony, The Olive and one project by The Zero, and several are pre-sale or under construction with units listed under the foreign quota. Botanica Skyport is a pool-villa project for buyers who want a house near the airport; the area is also close to Blue Canyon Golf Club and Mai Khao.
suitableFor: Frequent travellers who value airport access
Buyers who want a quiet, natural beach
highlights: National park beach with shade trees
Nai Thon and Mai Khao beaches nearby

lifestyle: Nai Yang has beach restaurants, small shops and a local market. It is calm in the evenings; larger shopping centres are a drive away.
beaches: Nai Yang Beach is protected by an offshore reef, which makes it calmer than many west-coast beaches. Casuarina trees give shade, and the national park limits large-scale development along the sand.
rentalMarket: Nai Yang rentals benefit from airport proximity: short stays at the start or end of a holiday and guests who want a quiet beach. Long-term demand comes from airport and hospitality staff.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: unique airport access and a protected beach. Limitations: aircraft noise in some locations and fewer amenities.

investment: Nai Yang appeals to buyers who value convenience and calm over nightlife. Check flight paths and noise for specific projects before buying.

faq.question: How close is Nai Yang to Phuket airport?
faq.answer: Our project data puts Nai Yang projects about 2 km from Phuket International Airport, often under 10 minutes by car.

faq.question: Is there aircraft noise in Nai Yang?
faq.answer: Planes approach over the coast here, so noise depends on the exact location. Visit the site at different times before buying.

faq.question: Is Nai Yang Beach good for swimming?
faq.answer: Yes, the offshore reef keeps it calmer than many west-coast beaches, especially in the dry season.

faq.question: Is Nai Yang part of a national park?
faq.answer: Nai Yang Beach is within Sirinat National Park, which limits development along the beach.

faq.question: Is Nai Yang a good place to live?
faq.answer: It suits people who want a quiet beach village and quick airport access; larger shopping and nightlife areas are further south.
